sections: docs/RESEARCH.md technical stack and CI/VPC sections

gaps.title: Remove conflicting current architecture authority
gaps.ma_concept: MA has a central architecture, area pages, a plan and an explicit decisions/open-questions map.
gaps.mp_evidence: MP current deep dive and ten-layer pack coexist with six-phase implementation-plan, bootstrap ADRs and contributor rules mentioning older storage, runtime and budget choices.
gaps.recommendation: Make one versioned MP baseline the authority; preserve dated evidence as historical and replace conflicting current instructions. Add a decision precedence table and a source-to-phase-to-story crosswalk. Do not turn all ten layers into separately approved architectures.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve baseline structure, decision owner and handling of superseded ADRs.
acceptance_criteria: Every current instruction resolves to the same £100 all-in/direct Anthropic/DynamoDB-preferred direction.
Every unselected option is marked open with an owner and deciding evidence.
One current phase map has explicit historical epic crosswalk.

gaps.title: Settle agent roles, SDK loop and memory authority
gaps.ma_concept: MA separates deterministic responsibilities from LLM work and centralises tools, cache and scoped memory in a thin client runner.
gaps.mp_evidence: MP proposes nine logical responsibilities but only four Claude task routes plus one code coordinator; production manifest is not agreed.
gaps.recommendation: Retain one controlled Anthropic client runner; specify deterministic work separately from Claude routes, with role/tool/context/budget/eval contracts. Keep Haiku/Sonnet classes as candidates and pin evaluated IDs later. Memory notes must have source, expiry, taint and correction/deletion semantics and may never replace ledger facts or approved settings.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve role-to-route catalogue, memory authority and per-route tool/budget limits; no automatic Opus route.
acceptance_criteria: A table enumerates each responsibility, trigger, compute unit, model-if-any, tools, outputs and forbidden operations.
Ask/approve exits Lambda and resumes from a typed pending action rather than waiting for the owner.
Model/prompt/tool/memory-version changes identify affected safety suites and require appropriate approval.

gaps.title: Separate batch deadlines from live work and justify caching
gaps.ma_concept: MA uses Haiku batches for news and overnight judging plus stable-prefix caching. Some MA prose also mentions batch-generated briefing narration.
gaps.mp_evidence: MP correctly makes 07:30 briefing/material risk independent of a newly submitted batch, but exact batch schedule, retry and cache economics are not specified.
gaps.recommendation: Use batch only for nonurgent enrichment and bounded evals. Deadline-aware submission/polling and per-item state prevent delayed results from rewriting already-issued evidence. Cache eligible stable prefixes only when expected reuse pays its write premium; no artificial warming or guaranteed hit-rate assumption.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve batch-eligible workloads, freshness cutoffs, late-result policy and per-route cache policy.
acceptance_criteria: Pending batch liability is reserved once and reconciled by item/custom ID; unordered, expired and partial results have cases.
The briefing uses last-valid dated evidence, deterministic prose or pending labels when the batch misses its cutoff.
Cold-cache, no-cache, best-effort batch-hit and per-model-version cost cases are costed.

gaps.title: Specify the authenticated SSE delivery contract and operating budget
gaps.ma_concept: MA proposes Regional REST streaming through Python Web Adapter, durable event log and frequently polled live buffers.
gaps.mp_evidence: MP has a local volatile sample stream and proposed separate streaming Lambda; durable contract and open-connection costs are not yet accepted.
gaps.recommendation: Keep short commands/queries and durable jobs separate from observation. Recommend Regional REST API streaming with explicit Python Web Adapter compatibility, bounded stream lifetime, per-device/tab connection caps and event IDs. Replace the MA 200ms/1-second polling targets with a measured latency/cost envelope suited to personal use.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve replay retention, latency target, auth/session approach, refresh/reconnect and polling cadence.
acceptance_criteria: Specify handshake/auth, event schema, ordering, after-cursor, heartbeat, resync and logout/revocation behaviour.
Disconnect does not cancel an accepted job or trigger duplicate provider calls.
Cost scenario counts active device hours, Lambda GB-seconds, DynamoDB reads and reconnect bursts; no all-day stream assumed free.

gaps.title: Define queue, outbox, replay and external-side-effect semantics
gaps.ma_concept: MA puts handoffs through SQS and describes safe idempotent retries and replay.
gaps.mp_evidence: MP proposed job/outbox and separate scheduler/worker DLQs are stronger than a blanket exactly-once claim but need a complete message catalogue.
gaps.recommendation: Use stable business IDs, durable claims/leases and an atomic application outbox. Standard SQS for independent work; FIFO only for ordering that is actually required, such as a conversation. Distinguish scheduler target failures from worker failures; quarantine permanent invalid inputs without infinite retries.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve queue topology, ordering partitions, retention/replay authority and ambiguous-provider-call reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: Message table defines producer/consumer, schema, key, ordering, lease, visibility, max attempts, concurrency and failure destination.
Crash cases span before/after provider submission, database commit, outbox dispatch and acknowledgement; ambiguous paid calls are not blindly resubmitted.
Partial batch failure/FIFO order and stale or expired owner approvals have explicit cases.

gaps.title: Choose one orchestration mechanism for cross-service jobs
gaps.ma_concept: MA selects Step Functions plus EventBridge for its later team.
gaps.mp_evidence: MP leaves Step Functions versus Lambda Durable Functions open, with a starter Python3.12 runtime and optional SageMaker jobs.
gaps.recommendation: Recommend Step Functions Standard for the proposed cross-service SageMaker/import/approval workflows because visual state and native service joins match the requested technical/admin evidence. Compare Lambda Durable Functions as the code-first alternative rather than adding both by default. State-machine payloads should carry opaque references, not private documents or credentials.
gaps.decision_needed: Owner selects Step Functions versus Durable Functions after a representative failure/retry/wait/cost comparison.
acceptance_criteria: One representative import and train-evaluate-approve journey is specified in both alternatives with equivalent guarantees.
Runtime/container/SDK/region evidence is explicit: managed durable Python3.13/3.14 are listed, while OCI images support additional versions; Python3.12 is not declared impossible.
Replay/timeout/cancellation state retention and sensitive-payload redaction are documented.

gaps.title: Separate SageMaker training from inference hosting
gaps.ma_concept: MA plans small Lambda training/inference with container fallback; MP explicitly requested a SageMaker architecture scenario.
gaps.mp_evidence: MP two-family SageMaker diagram remains a proposal, not a final training or serving ADR.
gaps.recommendation: Recommend capped on-demand CPU SageMaker candidate training/evaluation, S3 model/evidence references and owner-approved portable Lambda inference where compatibility permits. Daily scheduled inference can run once per eligible universe/horizon then serve stored results. Keep Batch Transform or on-demand Serverless Inference as measured alternatives, with no always-on endpoint or provisioned concurrency by default.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve managed training value, job cap/cadence and inference host after representative artifact/resource/cost evidence.
acceptance_criteria: Model registry records artifact hash, data cutoff, splits, features, calibration and approval; it need not imply a paid always-on tracking server.
Serving estimates compare stored daily results/Lambda, Batch Transform and Serverless with loading/cold-start/egress/storage included.
Serverless exclusions are explicit: no VPC configuration, network isolation, data capture or Model Monitor; private-training controls do not automatically transfer.

gaps.title: Prove financial visibility and audit atomicity before accepting DynamoDB keys
gaps.ma_concept: MA uses a single-table document registry and transactions with audit history.
gaps.mp_evidence: MP prefers DynamoDB but already notes large-import staging and a possible relational alternative; implementation-ready access/invariant specification is missing.
gaps.recommendation: Keep typed financial entities independent of persistence and approve access patterns first. Recommend DynamoDB only if staged imports, corrections, audit/outbox and concurrent account writes have one consistent commit-visibility rule. Keep queryable Parquet evidence in S3; do not force all history into one growing item.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve ledger/import atomicity and access pattern contract under existing MP-12, including whether a relational fallback is needed.
acceptance_criteria: Model large imports beyond100 actions/4MB and persistent idempotency beyond the10-minute service token window.
Every reader/projection/export/replay honours the import commit marker; failed staging cannot change holdings.
Before/after audit, commit marker and outbox invariants are explicit and restore/rebuild cases link MP-13.

gaps.title: Design verified account linking and protected owner actions
gaps.ma_concept: MA has per-environment Cognito, managed identity, device controls and a fresh second check for sensitive admin actions.
gaps.mp_evidence: MP owner chose Apple, Google and passkeys with managed sign-in; recovery, federation linking, reauthentication and token/session architecture remain open.
gaps.recommendation: Use Cognito managed sign-in and explicit verified linking to an owner identity; never merge users from email equality alone. Keep browser cookie/CSRF and native PKCE/token storage designs separate. Bind a fresh step-up proof to a specific sensitive action and its proposed values, with expiry and server checks.
gaps.decision_needed: Resolve under MP-11: linking enrolment/recovery, step-up proof, devices, token revocation and two independent passkey recovery paths.
acceptance_criteria: Document sign-in/link/recovery/revoke sequences for Apple, Google and local passkey identities, including lost-device/account cases.
Admin approvals bind owner, environment, action, payload hash and expiry; a generic logged-in session is insufficient.
Cross-environment tokens, stale approval, CSRF, linking takeover and native redirect interception have negative cases.

gaps.title: Select account, region and network boundaries for MP rather than inheriting MA
gaps.ma_concept: MA uses one named account/region and optional sophisticated VPC proxy/perimeter options.
gaps.mp_evidence: MP still has N0/N1/N1-E alternatives, cheapest-suitable-region preference and no selected accounts/region/IaC.
gaps.recommendation: Recommend N0 for external Anthropic/data-facing Lambdas initially and only a justified N1 private job scope. Compare cheapest suitable regions on all required services, data residency and total egress/telemetry charges. Compare separate dev/prod accounts against strict same-account isolation without duplicating MA domains, CIDRs or proxies.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve accounts, region, IaC and network option; VPN remains optional and does not substitute for auth.
acceptance_criteria: A boundary matrix identifies IAM principals and permitted resources/actions per env and function.
Gateway endpoints are not an Anthropic internet path; public-subnet attachment alone gives Lambda neither public IP nor internet access.
Any NAT/interface endpoint/proxy/VPN has operations/failure/cost justification and does not appear enabled by diagram.

gaps.title: Define MP release evidence and security regression layers
gaps.ma_concept: MA uses one build, dev validation, owner-approved prod promotion, rollback, path filtering and web/native/agent gates.
gaps.mp_evidence: MP current CI verifies starter/tooling/docs and is not a production web/native/release pipeline.
gaps.recommendation: Carry the gates and immutable-promotion concepts, not MA tool/version counts or automatic dev-apply permission. Recommend one IaC stack family, OIDC per environment, pinned builds/SBOM and artifact provenance; local/stub replay tests offline by default, paid evals separately capped and approved.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve build/test/release matrix, IaC choice, vulnerability policy, browser/device service choice and Mac CI budget.
acceptance_criteria: Matrix links changes to unit/contract/integration/numeric/security/agent/web/native checks and identifies which are offline versus paid.
One tested artifact is promoted with explicit prod approval and rollback evidence; source/data/schema/config changes have compatibility plans.
Scanner findings have severity/exploitability/exception expiry ownership; incomplete or budget-exhausted evals never become green.

gaps.title: Specify trace joins and telemetry budgets without universal trace claims
gaps.ma_concept: MA plans RunRecord, OTel/GenAI spans, client telemetry and CloudWatch investigations.
gaps.mp_evidence: MP carries business correlation and short-lived telemetry but exact SDK/exporter/sampling/cardinality contracts are open.
gaps.recommendation: Use durable business records as operational truth, with sampled OTel traces and explicit asynchronous links. A user action, a queue batch, a resumed approval and a stream session do not have to form one infinitely long parent-child trace. External provider internals are not observable solely because the SDK call is traced.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve telemetry backend/sampling/redaction and per-env cost envelope, coordinated with admin/audit lane.
acceptance_criteria: Define business/run/request/trace/span/message/provider IDs, propagation headers/attributes and link rules at every boundary.
Test redaction, context injection/forgery, sampled-out requests and multi-message batches; Activity remains complete when a span is absent.
Estimate dimensions, ingestion/query/retention/custom metrics/alarms rather than copying MA free-tier/£2.50 claims or assuming100% tracing.

gaps.title: Make cost admission conservative across concurrent work and shared credits
gaps.ma_concept: MA has per-agent shares, model degradation and provider token metering.
gaps.mp_evidence: MP already mandates£100 all-in,£70 operation/£30 reserve,£60/75/85 actions, per-env dashboard and no uncovered fallback; exact liabilities and allocations remain open.
gaps.recommendation: Reserve conservative maximum liability before paid submissions, track unknown/retrying/batch commitments and reconcile once. Keep gross, verified credit and cash separate, shared credit counted once across apps. Dashboard reads cached aggregates; bill reports remain delayed even if polled six-hourly/daily.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve per-feature ceilings, staleness policy, allowed degradation and how shared/unknown credits affect admission.
acceptance_criteria: Concurrent final-pence requests cannot each independently pass the same remaining budget.
Unknown credit/report availability refuses uncovered work; deterministic output remains available without silently upgrading paid routes.
Include source subscription, FX/tax assumptions, telemetry, builds, training, backups and collectors in baseline and stress recosts; no guarantee AWS billing instantly stops.

gaps.title: Fix web/native ownership and offline/privacy contracts before UX
gaps.ma_concept: MA defines an adaptive web app, native SwiftUI core in an RN shell, device integrations and testable static/prototype journeys.
gaps.mp_evidence: MP retained Swift/SwiftUI plus RN shell but has no approved bridge/runtime/device matrix; requested SvelteKit3 is not the existing React architecture Site.
gaps.recommendation: Recommend static SvelteKit PWA shell on S3/CloudFront with authenticated API data; add SSR only for a demonstrated need. Honour MP Swift ownership of native surfaces/cache/secure-device integration while RN owns navigation/bridge contracts. Define privacy-safe offline scope and durable reconnect independently for each platform.
gaps.decision_needed: Approve supported OS/devices (including what Duo means), cache/offline/push capabilities, bridge ownership and exact compatible stack; defer visual design until these contracts are settled.
acceptance_criteria: S3 static output does not imply SvelteKit server sessions/actions exist; session architecture is explicit.
Offline owner/data clearance, logout, expiry, stale results and app/service-worker update cases are specified.
Web and native have separate implementation stories using shared API/event contracts, not claims that one UI codebase is shared; widgets/Siri/share-sheet/LiveActivities are individually phased.

research.title: API Gateway response streaming
research.claim: REST proxy streaming has integration and idle limits.
research.mp_implication: Bound stream lifetime and validate authenticated Python path.

research.title: Lambda response streaming
research.claim: Python can stream using a custom runtime or Lambda Web Adapter.
research.mp_implication: Do not assume the local ASGI stream or buffered adapter streams in Lambda.

research.title: Anthropic Message Batches
research.claim: Asynchronous processing can take up to24hours; results require item matching and partial/expiry handling.
research.mp_implication: Do not put immediate alerts or same-deadline fresh briefing evidence behind a new batch.

research.title: Anthropic prompt caching
research.claim: Caching matches prefixes and supports5-minute/1-hour TTLs with route/model economics.
research.mp_implication: Measure reuse and write/read cost; no guaranteed hit rate or warming.

research.title: Lambda SQS integration
research.claim: Event-source processing is at least once and partial batch handling is needed.
research.mp_implication: Idempotency is an application invariant, including external ambiguities.

research.title: Partial batch response best practices
research.claim: Failed items must be distinguished; FIFO requires preserving order after failure.
research.mp_implication: Define consumer-specific retry and quarantine cases.

research.title: Lambda durable functions
research.claim: Code-first checkpoints/waits and Step Functions provide different orchestration styles.
research.mp_implication: Select one main orchestrator on representative workflow evidence.

research.title: Durable runtime support
research.claim: Managed Python3.13/3.14 and OCI images for additional runtime versions are supported.
research.mp_implication: Do not reject all3.12 packaging on the basis of the managed-runtime list alone.

research.title: Step Functions with Lambda
research.claim: Visual cross-service orchestration includes native service joins.
research.mp_implication: Its fit for SageMaker/approval workflow is a recommendation, not approval.

research.title: SageMaker hosting choices
research.claim: Batch, asynchronous, serverless and real-time serving match different latency/workload shapes.
research.mp_implication: Daily stored forecasts do not inherently need an always-on endpoint.

research.title: SageMaker Serverless Inference
research.claim: On-demand scales to zero but excludes VPC/network-isolation/data-capture/Model-Monitor features.
research.mp_implication: Do not inherit private-training or managed-monitoring assumptions.

research.title: DynamoDB transaction contract
research.claim: A transaction is bounded by100actions/4MB and service request-token idempotency is time-limited.
research.mp_implication: Large import atomicity requires explicit application design.

research.title: Cognito authentication flows
research.claim: Federation and local/passkey authentication have distinct flows and linking considerations.
research.mp_implication: Specify the linked owner identity and recovery contract.

research.title: Cognito account consolidation
research.claim: Federated profiles can be linked to a local user; safe linking is a deliberate operation.
research.mp_implication: Email equality alone is not an ownership proof.

research.title: Lambda VPC connectivity
research.claim: A public-subnet attachment alone does not grant a Lambda public IP/internet.
research.mp_implication: Egress and optional private job boundaries must be specified/costed.

research.title: GitHub OIDC
research.claim: Workflow trust can exchange short-lived cloud credentials.
research.mp_implication: Scope trust by repository/ref/environment instead of storing long-lived deploy keys.

research.title: Lambda X-Ray
research.claim: Sampling and asynchronous linked traces exist; traces are not a durable business event log.
research.mp_implication: Define explicit joins and keep Activity evidence independent.

research.title: CloudWatch pricing
research.claim: Monitoring charges depend on selected signals, volume and feature use.
research.mp_implication: Reprice MP telemetry; MA free-tier totals are not an MP quote.

research.title: Anthropic Usage and Cost Analytics
research.claim: Historical usage/cost has account/API scope and reporting semantics.
research.mp_implication: Use report timestamps and internal reservations rather than treating reports as live credit enforcement.

research.title: SvelteKit static adapter
research.claim: Static output is a deployment mode distinct from dynamic server execution.
research.mp_implication: Pin rendering and session strategy before UX and deployment design.

research.title: Scheduler DLQ
research.claim: Scheduler target failure can be sent to a configured standard SQS DLQ.
research.mp_implication: Keep target invocation failure separate from downstream worker exhaustion.
